retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s collage style featuring vibrant orange spray textures, gestural black ink lines, and a central photographic inset of a musician.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition layering a central photographic portrait over a chaotic background of bright orange spray paint, rough black brushstrokes, and a continuous, looping thin black line that weaves through the frame. Large, ghosted sans-serif letters are vertically oriented on the left and right edges, appearing as if screen-printed with low opacity.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic square anchored by heavy black textured blocks
Vibrant orange spray field contrasting against off-white textured paper
Thin gestural line providing fluid movement against rigid geometric blocks
Ghosted vertical typography framing the central action
coreInvariants: High-saturation orange spray paint texture with visible overspray droplets
Continuous thin black looping line that intersects the central subject
Rough, torn-edge black ink blocks surrounding the central photo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small photographic square of a man playing a trumpet is positioned slightly left of center, scaled to occupy about 20% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy black textured block to the left of the photo and the vertical black brushstroke to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the looping black line from the top right, down through the center, and around the bottom, guided by the verticality of the side text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Off-white paper texture visible in the corners and between the spray paint clusters.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation orange against neutral off-white and high-contrast black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif and wide bold sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text is extremely narrow and tall
Ghosted background text is wide, blocky, and semi-transparent
characterSpecificRedesigns: Background letters feature a halftone or screen-print texture bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between ultra-condensed black foreground text and wide, faded background blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the display text.
Matches the blocky, wide skeleton of the ghosted background text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an abstract collage on off-white paper. Include a central square photo of a man playing a trumpet. Surround it with rough black ink blocks and a large, messy field of vibrant orange spray paint with visible splatters. Add a thin, continuous black looping line that travels across the composition. Place large, wide, semi-transparent grey block letters vertically along the left and right edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the title in the top right corner using an ultra-condensed bold black sans-serif font, aligned left with tight leading.

verificationChecks: Is the orange spray paint vibrant and textured?
Does the thin black line loop fluidly across the center?
Is the side typography ghosted and vertically oriented?
Is the central photo framed by rough black textures?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the ghosted background text
Subject of the central photographic inset
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the musician
Ensure the layout is a new arrangement of these specific stylistic elements

mustAchieve: Dynamic balance between chaos and structure

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible spray paint droplets and overspray
Ensure the looping line is thin and consistent in weight
Verify the background text looks like a faded screen print
Confirm the central photo is a distinct, hard-edged square
Check that the orange is the most saturated element
recipe.reuseFormula: Abstract Collage = (Spray Paint Texture + Gestural Ink Lines) * (Ghosted Block Typography) + Central Photographic Inset
